markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (89%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, full second-model and neighbor agreement, and only 1% invasive probability [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 89%, Normal 6%, Benign 4%, Invasive 1% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Intraductal pattern fits in situ disease [F4] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 0, 2, 3) · context · Lymphocyte-rich regions; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score high, but failed spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical; little stromal-invasion signal · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 8 carries a small invasive signal (risk 22%); invasive foci there would change the call.
- Reliability-error AUROC is modest (0.69, CI 0.58–0.87), so a high reliability score is weak assurance.

## Check on the slide
1. **8** — Only region pushing toward invasive (+0.28 logit); confirm in situ versus invasive growth.
2. **4, 8, 9** — Look for true mitoses; the model's mitosis score failed its spot check.
3. **8, 9, 10** — Tumor suggested at inferior margin in the simulated frozen section; medial also involved [F7].
